candidate_grammar.boundary: Every finite observation boundary with a positive counted set of completed instances of one reaction transition and a positive counted set of registered recurrence intervals, retaining species amount and conditions as source records.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the literal product of event, count, duration, boundary, relation, condition, record and extension choices.

excluded_inputs: no reaction dictionary, mechanism database, rate equation, Arrhenius law, equilibrium constant, measured target or V2 answer may select a candidate
no numerical zero, negative, irrational, imaginary or floating proof quantity
no free, fitted, learned or target-derived parameter
no chemical carrier may be created, copied or silently erased
an absent dependence or event is an empty structural form, never numerical zero
external target content remains inaccessible until the prediction is sealed
